notes: The validation launcher defaults to an isolated LOCAL_NON_PROD Unified Knowledge repository under the E2E data root.
Publish remains an explicit human action; no automatic review or automatic publish is enabled.
The managed local mode creates immutable Knowledge Release snapshots automatically after an explicit publish so Query Back can run without manual release stitching.
To use an external NON_PROD Unified Knowledge service instead, set HARDWARE_R1_E2E_KNOWLEDGE_MODE=EXTERNAL plus HARDWARE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_URL and HARDWARE_KNOWLEDGE_RELEASE_VERSION.
Provider credentials must be supplied only through environment variables; never store secrets in this file.
If an explicitly selected external NON_PROD environment is incomplete, Publish remains blocked.
